articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: BlackRock drives $217M Bitcoin ETF rebound as altcoin funds continue streaks
articles.description: Ether ETFs extended their inflow streak to 11 trading sessions, while XRP and Solana funds each logged a 10th consecutive positive session.

articles.title: Thailand SEC proposes retail access to regulated overseas crypto derivatives
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC seeks comments on rules requiring retail-accessible overseas crypto derivatives to trade on qualifying, centrally cleared exchanges.

articles.title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
articles.description: Ireland’s planned investment accounts will offer tax benefits for stocks, bonds and ETFs, while excluding crypto and derivatives as higher-risk products.

articles.title: Webull expands crypto trading into Canada through Coinbase collaboration
articles.description: The brokerage is adding digital assets alongside stocks, ETFs and options as Canadian crypto ownership rises and regulators move toward clearer industry rules.

articles.title: Bitcoin begins volatile monthly close as US bond yields eye new 20-year high
articles.description: Bitcoin price action saw sharp moves within its local range as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent addressed US bond yields.

articles.title: Bitmine now controls 4.9% of Ethereum supply after adding 53.5K ETH
articles.description: Bitmine has bought Ether for 65 consecutive weeks, maintaining its accumulation strategy through a prolonged crypto downturn and $5.1 billion in paper losses.

articles.title: Strive buys 1,800 Bitcoin for $143M, becomes fifth-biggest corporate holder
articles.description: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase lifted its holdings to 23,156 BTC, making it the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate holder as crypto markets rebound.

articles.title: Russian crypto trading to bring $46B to regulated exchanges in first year after legalization: Report
articles.description: Regulated cryptocurrency exchanges may see more than $46 billion in crypto trading volume during the first year after legalization, according to estimates from the country’s largest bank.

articles.title: Mystery surrounds why an OG burned $1M in Bitcoin
articles.description: The million dollar question is what prompted a Bitcoin OG to send 20 BTC to a custodian, retrieve it back, and then deliberately burn it?

articles.title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
articles.description: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.

articles.title: Metaplanet moves 4,800 BTC worth $377M to Coinbase
articles.description: The Japanese Bitcoin treasury company has transferred 10,270 BTC to Coinbase Prime this week, an amount equal to more than 29% of its reported holdings.

articles.title: Strategy buys $370M Bitcoin in first corporate purchase since June
articles.description: Strategy added to its BTC treasury for the first time in two months, while continuing to bolster its cash reserves and buy back its perpetual STRC preferred stock.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Pump.fun account for nearly 90% of record $638M crypto buybacks: FT
articles.description: Crypto projects spent a record $638 million on token buybacks so far in 2026, as more protocols are turning their revenue into buybacks to return more value to token holders.

articles.title: Markets pivot to September Fed rate hike: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin approached the August monthly close below key resistance with markets once again pricing in a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in September.

articles.title: More Markets lending reserve drained for $9.3M: Blockaid
articles.description: Blockaid said an attacker used an Ankr liquid staking token and E-mode to overborrow from More Markets and drain about $9.3 million in WFLOW from a lending reserve.

articles.title: Cronos halts network after Tectonic exploit involving estimated $75M
articles.description: Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek said the company’s app and exchange were unaffected by the Tectonic breach and continued operating normally.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s new quantum defenses, 18.9M SOL cancelled: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Bitcoin moves toward a post quantum future, Solana validators agree to curb rampant inflation and the bull case from Bernstein is for Bitcoin to peak at $500K this cycle.

articles.title: Saylor signals Strategy is ‘Back’ to Bitcoin buying
articles.description: Michael Saylor’s “We’re Back” post hints Strategy may resume Bitcoin buying after a two-month pause to strengthen its balance sheet.

articles.title: Russia’s Sber eyes USDT loans, questions digital ruble demand
articles.description: Russia’s largest bank, Sber, plans to accept USDT and Ether alongside Bitcoin as loan collateral as the country introduces regulated crypto trading under a new law.

articles.title: Real Trump Coins denies launching GOLD token, blames ‘bad actors’
articles.description: Trump-linked Real Trump Coins said it never authorized GOLD or any digital token as questions persisted over its X account, associated domains and the concentrated token supply.

articles.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
articles.description: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

articles.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
articles.description: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

articles.title: Tokenized stock transfer volume jumps 415% in 30 days to $29.5B
articles.description: Tokenized equities saw a sharp rise in onchain activity as active addresses and holders more than doubled over the past month.

articles.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
articles.description: Real Trump Coins promoted GOLD before deleting related X posts, while team-linked wallets sold 224.5 million tokens as its market value fell about 99%.

articles.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
articles.description: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.8 million in net outflows Friday, led by ARK 21Shares, as total fund assets slipped back below $100 billion.

articles.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
articles.description: The approved proposal doubles Solana’s annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, reducing future SOL issuance while leaving its long-term inflation target unchanged.

articles.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
articles.description: According to Circle, the USDC stablecoin name will appear on the front of club jerseys for Chelsea’s upcoming football season.

articles.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
articles.description: The institutional crypto exchange is providing $100 million in stablecoin liquidity to support loans backed by AI computing infrastructure.
